rv.q: This “Akhnaten” staging is not as revelatory as the “Satyagraha.”
With its army of jugglers, its sexy robes, architectural headgear, and bejeweled everything, this Akhnaten gratifies the desire for decadent blitheness and high-minded spectacle.
Akhnaten is easily one of the finest things to ever appear at the Met.
“Akhnaten” undeniably rules at the Met and it may be some time before its audiences see anything of this divine quality.

cn.t: Critics hail this visually stunning production as a Met triumph, with Anthony Roth Costanzo's performance and McDermott's opulent staging earning widespread praise, though one reviewer finds the lavishness excessive.
